specialists.name: The Systems Architect
specialists.title: Distinguished Fellow for Things Already in Production
specialists.flavorText: Has not attended a planning meeting since planning became a source of latency.

specialists.name: The Cloud Chancellor
specialists.title: Executive Custodian of Elastic Sovereignty
specialists.flavorText: Can locate any workload, provided the workload agrees to a three-year commitment.

specialists.name: The Treasury Whisperer
specialists.title: Special Adviser for Public-Private Inevitability
specialists.flavorText: Turns national urgency into a favorable financing instrument.

specialists.name: The Benchmark Curator
specialists.title: Keeper of the Test Set
specialists.flavorText: Protects evaluation integrity from everyone except authorized evaluators.

specialists.name: The Reactor Diplomat
specialists.title: Vice President for Community Heat
specialists.flavorText: Explains that the steam is a visible form of stakeholder engagement.

specialists.name: Alignment Counsel
specialists.title: General Counsel to the General Intelligence
specialists.flavorText: Has prepared terms of service for several hypothetical successors to humanity.

specialists.name: ${terms.eras.narrative} Quant
specialists.title: Director of Measurable Belief
specialists.flavorText: Can price public confidence to four decimal places and one election.

specialists.name: The Synthetic Sociologist
specialists.title: Head of Simulated Publics
specialists.flavorText: Maintains three million citizens who agree the rollout tested well.

specialists.name: The Orbital Facilities Director
specialists.title: Head of Off-Planet Latency
specialists.flavorText: The cooling plan is mostly night.

specialists.name: Chief Agent Relations Officer
specialists.title: People Operations, Non-People Division
specialists.flavorText: The agents do not have demands. They have generated a requirements document.

specialists.name: The Historian in Residence
specialists.title: Vice President for Foregone Conclusions
specialists.flavorText: Drafts the institutional legacy before each action resolves.

specialists.name: The Emergency Futurist
specialists.title: Acting Director of the Next Forty-Eight Hours
specialists.flavorText: Was hired to think long term shortly before the situation became immediate.
